mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMM_POST (POST_SEQ, USR_ID, POST_TTL, POST_CN, POST_STAT, VIS_TYP, POST_DTM, FRST_REG_USER_ID) VALUES (#{postSeq}, #{usrId}, #{title}, #{content}, 'ACTIVE', #{visibility}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{usrId})
INSERT INTO TB_COMM_POST_FILE (POST_SEQ, FIL_SEQ, SORT_ORD, MEDIA_TYP, FRST_REG_USER_ID) VALUES (#{postSeq}, #{filSeq}, #{sortOrder}, #{mediaType}, #{usrId})
mapper.select: SELECT P.POST_SEQ AS postSeq, P.USR_ID AS authorId, U.USR_NM AS authorName, P.POST_CN AS content, to_char(P.POST_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMM_POST_LIKE L WHERE L.POST_SEQ=P.POST_SEQ) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMM_CMT C WHERE C.POST_SEQ=P.POST_SEQ AND C.CMT_STAT='ACTIVE') AS commentCount, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_COMM_POST_LIKE L WHERE L.POST_SEQ=P.POST_SEQ AND L.USR_ID=#{usrId}) AS likedByMe, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_COMM_POST_SAVE S WHERE S.POST_SEQ=P.POST_SEQ AND S.USR_ID=#{usrId}) AS savedByMe FROM TB_COMM_POST P JOIN TB_USR U ON U.USR_ID=P.USR_ID WHERE P.POST_STAT='ACTIVE' AND ( (#{feedType}='mine' AND P.USR_ID=#{usrId}) OR (#{feedType}<>'mine' AND (P.VIS_TYP='PUBLIC' OR P.USR_ID=#{usrId} OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM TB_COMM_FOLLOW F WHERE F.FOLLOWER_USR_ID=#{usrId} AND F.FOLLOWING_USR_ID=P.USR_ID AND F.FOLLOW_STAT='ACCEPTED')))) AND (#{feedType}='mine' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_COMM_POST_SEEN V WHERE V.POST_SEQ=P.POST_SEQ AND V.USR_ID=#{usrId})) AND (#{feedType} <> 'following' OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM TB_COMM_FOLLOW F WHERE F.FOLLOWER_USR_ID=#{usrId} AND F.FOLLOWING_USR_ID=P.USR_ID AND F.FOLLOW_STAT='ACCEPTED')) ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{feedType}='mine' THEN 0 WHEN #{feedType}='popular' THEN 0 WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM TB_COMM_FOLLOW F WHERE F.FOLLOWER_USR_ID=#{usrId} AND F.FOLLOWING_USR_ID=P.USR_ID AND F.FOLLOW_STAT='ACCEPTED') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN #{feedType}='popular' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMM_POST_LIKE L WHERE L.POST_SEQ=P.POST_SEQ) ELSE 0 END DESC, P.POST_DTM DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT PF.FIL_SEQ AS filSeq, PF.MEDIA_TYP AS mediaType, D.CONT_TYP AS contentType FROM TB_COMM_POST_FILE PF JOIN FIL_DTL D ON D.FIL_SEQ=PF.FIL_SEQ WHERE PF.POST_SEQ=#{postSeq} ORDER BY PF.SORT_ORD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMM_POST_SEEN (USR_ID, POST_SEQ, SEEN_DTM) VALUES (#{usrId}, #{postSeq}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (USR_ID, POST_SEQ) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO TB_COMM_POST_LIKE (POST_SEQ, USR_ID) VALUES (#{postSeq}, #{usrId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_COMM_POST_LIKE WHERE POST_SEQ=#{postSeq} AND USR_ID=#{usrId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMM_POST_SAVE (POST_SEQ, USR_ID) VALUES (#{postSeq}, #{usrId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_COMM_POST_SAVE WHERE POST_SEQ=#{postSeq} AND USR_ID=#{usrId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMM_POST_FILE PF JOIN TB_COMM_POST P ON P.POST_SEQ=PF.POST_SEQ WHERE PF.FIL_SEQ=#{filSeq} AND P.POST_STAT='ACTIVE' AND (P.VIS_TYP='PUBLIC' OR P.USR_ID=#{usrId} OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM TB_COMM_FOLLOW F WHERE F.FOLLOWER_USR_ID=#{usrId} AND F.FOLLOWING_USR_ID=P.USR_ID AND F.FOLLOW_STAT='ACCEPTED'))
